findings.message: Newtonsoft.Json.JsonSerializerSettings.TypeNameAssemblyFormat is obsolete in the target (CS0618: 'JsonSerializerSettings.TypeNameAssemblyFormat' is obsolete: 'TypeNameAssemblyFormat is obsolete. Use TypeNameAssemblyFormatHandling instead.'); use TypeNameAssemblyFormatHandling.
findings.recommendation: Move to the replacement; with warnings as errors the upgrade does not build until then.

findings.message: Contoso.Orders.Comment contains itself, and site Contoso.Orders.CommentCodec.Read#1 reads it without MaxDepth: the target stops at 64 levels.
findings.recommendation: Set MaxDepth on the settings (or the reader) if payloads can nest deeper than 64 levels.
findings.note: 13.0.1: JsonReader and JsonSerializer MaxDepth defaults to 64
